tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i mchod 'bum bzhugs so: :

rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: bsod nams tshogs chen myur rdzogs phyir: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i mchod 'bum bri: de yang klong gsal rgyud dag las: sangs rgyas rigs lnga kun 'dus gtso: rang rig bla ma kun tu bzang : phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod 'bum ni: de yi bsod nams brjod mi lang : mchod 'bum 'di la spyi don bcu: dang po bka' bsgo ba dang gcig: mtshams bcad pa dang gnyis: phyag rgya bzung ba dang gsum: byin gyis rlob pa dang bzhi: spyan drang ba dang lnga: bzhugs su gsol ba dang drug: phyag 'tshal ba dang bdun: mchod pa 'bul ba dang brgyad: bstod pa bya ba dang dgu: bshags pa bya ba dang bcu'o: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ni: 'di skad do: hūm̐ nga ni kun bzang rigs lnga'i gtso: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mchod kyi: mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog bar gcod bgegs: 'di ru ma gnas gzhan du dengs: hūṃ hūṃ u tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa: ces brjod: bgegs rnams bskrad par bya'o: de nas bgegs mtshams bcad pa ni: rab 'jigs khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: hūṃ nga ni khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: dpal chen bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang : sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur nas: gdug pa 'dul bar rab bsngags pa: me ri mtshon cha rdo rje'i rwa: khro tshogs 'bar bas mtshams bcad do: raṃ hūm̐ bh+rū?ṃ dhi ha raṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa phaṭa: ces mtshams bcad do: de nas phyag rgya bzung ba ni: lag tu rdo rje dril bu bzung la: hūṃ thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: 'das dus 'gro rnams sad pa'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil: badz+ra dharmā hūṃ āḥ de nas mchod pa byin gyis rlob pa ni: swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis rdzas rnams bsangs: oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ: oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhuṣ+pe hūṃḥ ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai be te oṃ āḥbadz+ra shab+ta hūṃ: zhes brjod cing byin gyis brlab par bya: de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni:

mngon rtogs bzhin du bskyed la: spyan drang ba 'di skad do: hūṃ dus gsum bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku: nyon mongs lnga dag phung po gnas gyur pa'i: sku gsum lnga ldan rigs lnga yab yum tshogs: 'gro ba'i don du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ gu ru hūṃ traṃḥhrī ā: badz+ra aṃ gu sha dza: zhes pas thibs kyis byon par bsam: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūṃ sgyu ma chu zla ye shes gzhal yas khang : skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: oṃ ma pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra ka ma le hūṃ: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūṃ sku gsum mi 'gyur kun tu bzang : bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: chos nyid don la g.yo ba mi mnga' yang : longs sku 'ja' tshon lta bus 'gro don mdzad: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūṃ srid par gtogs pa'i me tog sna tshogs rigs: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing kha'i mdangs ldan pa'i: mdzes ldan dri zhim me tog ji snyed rnams: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ a badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ: hūm̐ srid par gtogs pa'i bdug spos ji snyed rnams: tsan+dan du ru ka dang a ka ru la sogs: dri zhim bsung ldan bdug spos ji snyed rnams: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: rig stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+re dhū pe hūṃ: hūm̐ srid par gtogs pa'i snang gsal ji snyed rnams: 'bru mar rtsi mar la sogs rtswa shing 'od kyi mdangs: dkar gsal mdangs chen snang gsal ji snyed rnams: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: gsal stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra ā lo ke hūṃ: hūṃ srid par gtogs pa'i dri chab bde ba'i mchog: tsan+dan gurgum si la lde gu sogs: rang byung sbyar ba'i byug pa bde byed rnams:

bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bde stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra ghan+dhe hūṃ: hūṃ srid par gtogs pa'i zhal zas ji snyed pa: rang byung lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i zas: g.yos mchog gtsang ma'i zhal zas sna tshogs rnams: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bde stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra ni be te hūṃ: hūṃ srid par gtogs pa'i rol mo sna tshogs rigs: rnga dung dha ting g.yer kha dril bu rdza rnga sogs: 'byung ba'i rang sgra glu gar rol mo'i dbyangs: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: grags stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra shab+ta hūṃ: de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūṃ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong gzugs: rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra rū pa pra ti dza hūṃ: hūṃ snod bcud snang srid yid du 'ong ba'i sgra: rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra shab+ta hūṃ: hūṃ snod bcud snang srid yid 'ong dri zhim spos: rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra ghan+dhe hūṃ: hūṃ snod bcud snang srid ro brgya ldan pa'i zas: rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra nai be te hūṃ: hūṃ snod bcud snang srid dbang du bde ba'i reg: rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol:

oṃ ā badz+ra spar she hūṃ: de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūṃ gsang mchod sku yi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams: gsang mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra a dar she hūṃ: hūṃ gsang mchod gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dmar mdzes rnga zlum sgra sgrog ma: gsang mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ: hūṃ gsang mchod thugs kyi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog mthing mdzes pi wang sgra sgrog ma: gsang mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra byi ni hūṃ: hūṃ gsang mchod yon tan bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ser mdzes gling bu'i sgra sgrog ma: gsang mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra waṃ se hūṃ: hūṃ gsang mchod phrin las bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ljang mdzes rdza rnga'i sgra sgrog ma: gsang mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ā badz+ra mi dhe ke hūṃ: zhes gsang mchod 'bul lo: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūṃ bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku: nyag gcig mtha' bral lu gu rgyud: cir mi dgongs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ zhe sdang rnam shes rang grol dbyings: me long ye shes dkar gsal sku: chu khams rnam dag yab yum rol: mi bskyod yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ 'dod chags 'du shes rnam dag dbyings: sor rtogs ye shes dmar gsal sku: me khams rnam dag yab yum rol: snang mtha' yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ gti mug gzugs khams rang grol dbyings: chos dbyings ye shes mthing gsal sku: nam mkha' rnam dag yab yum rol: rnam snang yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ nga rgyal tshor ba rnam dag dbyings: mnyam nyid ye shes ser gsal sku: sa khams rnam dag yab yum rol: rin 'byung yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ phrag dog 'du byed rnam dbyings:

bya grub ye shes ljang gsal sku: rlung khams rnam dag yab yum rol: don grub yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūṃ ma 'gags rig rtsal sgo ma bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rigs kyi mdog: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa dang : hūṃ bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga ni: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'phro: mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem sgeg bzhad ldan: ye shes rang mdangs phyi nang med: rigs lnga yab yum sku la bstod: snyan ting 'ur chom rang byung sgra: grags stong dbyer med kun la khyab: rigs lnga yab yum gsung la bstod: ye shes thig le lu gu rgyud: rig stong mtha' bral rang byung gsal: rigs lnga yab yum thugs la bstod: bde stong ye shes kun khyab dbyings: sdug bsngal rang grol bde ba rgyas: rigs lnga yab yum yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: rig mdangs stong gsal kun la shar: ma 'gags rtsal rdzogs phrin las mdzad: rigs lnga yab yum phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa dang : bstod pa gzhan yang bya'o: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: gnong 'gyod sems kyis thal mo sbyar: hūṃ bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga sogs: yi dam ḍāk+ki chos skyong dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gis su: sku gsung thugs dang yan lag sogs: dam tshig nyams par gyur pa kun: mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags: klong yangs ngang du bzod par bzhes: zhes pas yi ge brgya pa brjod do: de nas skabs la bab na lha gshegs: bsngo ba dang smon lam: bkra shis la sogs pa bya'o: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i mchod 'bul 'di: phyi rabs bsod nams bsags phyir bkod: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: a+thi+-i: ༄༅/ /rigs lnga'i gtor ma'i lag len bzhugs so: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni: snod thod pa'am rat+nar gtor ma 'bru lnga la sogs pa las byas te:

rgyan du dkar dmar dang spod sna tshogs pas bran la: ci 'byor du bshams te: swa bhā was stong par sbyangs: gtor ma'i 'og du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor: de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor: de'i steng du kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed po gsum: de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin de'i steng du a las zla ba'i kha bkab: dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa la oṃ ā hūṃ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ sngags de rnams kyis mtshan pa zhig bsam: de nas bdag yi dam lha'i thugs ka nas sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas yam̐ la phog pas rlung g.yos: rlung gis me sbar: mes thod pa'i bdud rtsi khol nas rlangs pa sku gsung thugs dang rigs lnga'i sa bon la phog pas rigs lnga yab yum du gyur nas snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar: zla ba'i kha bkab rdo rje dang bcas pa bdud rtsir zhu nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par bsam: de nas ngag tu yi ge gsum dang lnga pa brjod pas:de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki chos skyong rnams: snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar babs pas: ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa stong gsum 'jig rte gyi khams thams cad gang bar bsam: de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas: slar mgron thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs nas mchod par bsam zhing : ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐: kun bzang yab yum chos kyi sku: longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs: sprul sku pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: sku gsum dbyer med rigs lnga'i tshogs: yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: yi dam lha tshogs ma lus dang : dpa' bo ḍāk+ki chos skyong bcas: dam can bka' yi srung ma rnams:

ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: bha liṃ brgyan gyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: bla ma'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: yi dam tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: ḍāk+ki'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: chos skyong tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: lha srin sde brgyad tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: yul lha gter bdag tshogs rnams mchod pa bzhes: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub zhu: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang drag: dgug bskrad mnan gzir phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni: pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni: i daṃ bha wiṃ ta ghṛ h+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ: ha ri ni sa: rā tsa hrī ya: mahā kā la: ma mar ka mo: ya ma ra tsa: du tri phu tri i daṃ bha lid+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pa dang : rang rang gang byed thams cad la: rtsa sngags kyis lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul lo: phyi gtor thams cad gzhan dang mthun no: gtor ma'i lag len rdzogs so: a+thi+-i: rigs lnga'i tshogs mchod bzhugs so: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen bags pa dang : bar chod bsal dang dngos grub 'byung phyir du: tshogs kyi mchod pa'i cho ga bstan par bya: de yag klong gsal rgyud dag las: tshogs med gang yang 'grub mi 'gyur: ces pas: cho ga'i bye brag la spyi don bzhi ste: dang po tshogs kyi bye brag sha chang la sogs pa'i zas sna dang yo byad dpag tu med pa bshams la swa bhā wa'i chus bsangs te: tshogs kyi dngos po'i dri ma sbyang ba ni: hūm̐ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyi: chos rnams sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: dngos dang dngos 'dzin bag chags rnams: 'byung ba me chu rlung gsum gyis: bag chags bsreg sbyang gtor ba'i phyir: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las 'od 'phros pas: me yis bsreg dang chu yis bshal:

rlung gis gtor bas thams cad dag: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: zhes lan gsum brjod pas thams cad dag par bsam mo: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūṃḥ oṃ hūṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.ā: yi ge gsum dang lnga pa tshogs kyi nang du 'phros pas tshogs ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam zhing : oṃ āḥhūṃ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin las: zhal zas tshogs kyi dngos po yi ge oṃ: oṃ dkar sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang ye shes bdud rtsir zhu: chos dbyings ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: rnam snang yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs: me long ye shes rang bzhin las: zhal zas tshogs kyi dngos po yi ge hūṃ: hūṃ sngon sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang ye shes bdud rtsir zhu: me long ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: mi bskyod yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs: mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin las: zhal zas tshogs kyi dngos po yi ge trāṃ: trāṃ ser sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang ye shes bdud rtsir zhu: mnyam nyid ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: rin 'byung yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs: sor rtogs ye shes rang bzhin las: zhal zas tshogs kyi dngos po yi ge hrī: hrī dmar sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang ye shes bdud rtsir zhu: sor rtogs ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: snang mtha' yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs: nan tan ye shes rang bzhin las: zhal zas tshogs kyi dngos po yi ge āḥ ā ljang sgra dang bcas pa yis: tshogs kyang ye shes bdud rtsir zhu: bya grub ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: don grub yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs: bla ma kun bzang yab yum dang : rig 'dzin yab yum brgyud par bcas: o rgyan pad+ma yab yum dang : sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha: zhi khro khrag 'thung ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: chos skyong lha srin 'khor dang bcas: gzhi bdag dkar phyogs theg chen rigs: thams cad yab yum 'khor dang bcas: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

ces tshogs byin gyis brlabs shing yul spyan drangs pa'o: de nas tshogs mchod cing bstab pa dang bshags shing dngos grub zhu ba ni: oṃ āḥhūṃ: oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: kun bzang yab yum chos kyi sku: longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs: sprul sku rig 'dzin mkha' spyod bzhugs: tshogs kyi mchod 'bul dngos grub zhu: thugs dam gnyan skong nyams pa bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: rigs lnga yab yum yi dam tshogs: ḍāk+ki dpa' bo dam can rnams: rgyal chen rigs bzhi phyogs skyong bcu: snang srid lha srin bstan mar bcas: yul lha gzhi bdag dkar phyogs rnams: tshogs kyi mchod 'bul dngos grub zhu: thugs dam gnyan skong nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: ces brjod cing tshogs mchod tshar ba'i rjes la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhāk+ki ni oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ āḥ baṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ: e ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya shrī ma hā kā la ma ma rag+mo ya ma ra tsa du tri phu tri ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma hā su ra khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā ha

ི : ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: si ti hūm̐: zhes rol mo dang bcas pas 'bul loḥ de nas tshogs gtor phul la rnal 'byor pho mo rnams dgongs pa dang ldan pas tshogs la rol bar bya'o: lhag chog gzhan dang mthun no: rgya rgya rgya: rang bzhin lha yi dkyil 'khor la: mchod phyir tshogs kyi las rim 'di: bsod nams tshogs chen bsags phyir bkod: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: kun kyang bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas: theg chen sa la 'khod par shog: tshogs kyi lag len bsdus pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: a+thi+-i mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (5)bde gshegs rigs lnga'i mchod 'bum/ - PAGE 146 - - PAGE 145 -- PAGE 136 -
